page.layout: One printed page, blank except for a woodcut ornament in the centre (a winged horse above a caduceus flanked by serpents and foliage) and a faint catchmark or signature at the foot.
page.notes: The page contains only a woodcut printer's ornament (winged horse above a staff with entwined serpents, wings and foliage, with cloud-like scrolls at the base). No printed words are legible. A faint mark at the lower centre (approximately "A" with a small stroke) may be a signature remnant but is not legible enough to transcribe. The black book-cover edge at the left and the dark background are the digitiser's scan surround and are not transcribed.
